map.浏览器内直接调用摄像头录制视频（WebM 格式）：实时预览、开始/停止、下载录制: Record video from your camera directly in the browser (WebM format): live preview, start/stop recording and download the file, all captured locally with nothing uploaded.
map.调用浏览器媒体 API 采集摄像头画面并录制为视频文件。: Captures the camera feed through browser media APIs and records it to a video file.
map.获取媒体流，绑定到 video 元素预览。: Fetch the media stream and bind it to a video element for preview.
map.录制流，数据在: records the stream; chunks of data arrive via
map.：需 HTTPS 或 localhost（安全上下文），且用户明确授权摄像头权限: : needs HTTPS or localhost (a secure context) plus explicit user permission for the camera.
map.检测容器/编码支持（常为 WebM）。: to detect container and codec support (usually WebM).
map.🔒 视频仅在本地录制与保存，不会上传任何服务器。首次使用需授予摄像头/麦克风权限: 🔒 Video is recorded and saved locally only and is never uploaded to any server. Camera and microphone permission is required on first use. The recording format is WebM (supported by Chrome, Edge and Firefox).
map.调用 getUserMedia 在本地录制视频/截图。: Uses getUserMedia to capture video or still frames locally.
map.录制操作教程或问题复现视频：在不装任何软件的前提下，用浏览器直接录屏级演示，导出: Recording walkthroughs or bug-reproduction clips: capture a screen-level demo straight from the browser with no software installed, then export it and attach it to a ticket.
map.授权摄像头后录制为 webm（纯前端，不上传）。: After granting camera access it records to webm (fully client-side, no upload).
map.需用户授权摄像头，且仅 HTTPS/localhost 可用。: Yes, the user must authorize the camera, and it only works over HTTPS or localhost.
map.为什么浏览器请求不了摄像头？: Why can't the browser access the camera?
map.常见原因有三：页面不是 HTTPS（localhost 除外），浏览器会直接拒绝: There are three common causes: the page is not served over HTTPS (localhost excepted), so the browser rejects getUserMedia outright; the user dismissed the permission prompt and has not reset it; or the operating system itself (the Camera privacy setting on macOS, camera permissions on Windows) blocks that browser. Check them one by one.
